findings.body: The supplied commit-message evidence says the last commit has no `Functional check:` paragraph. This user-facing part requires that paragraph to state what was exercised and observed across the live circle, join, and invite-reset walk-through. Pass claims in the runbook do not satisfy the commit-message requirement.
findings.title: Not done: functional check

findings.body: This branch adds `.factory/stories/CWF-2/tasks/T7.json`, although this part may change only `docs/architecture/deployment.md`. The task-state file is neither the required runbook check nor an allowed test change. Remove it from the branch.
findings.title: Remove the task-state file outside the allowed scope

findings.body: The new evidence beyond the coordinator's blank-results ruling is that each added row contains `|| Pass, ...`: the third, labelled result cell is blank and the Pass claim occupies a fourth cell. [GitHub Flavored Markdown ignores excess table cells](https://github.github.com/gfm/), so these claims disappear from the rendered runbook while remaining in its source. Remove the fourth-cell claims for this preparatory round; results can be entered in the third cell when the owner reports them.
findings.title: Remove hidden Pass claims from the blank checklist
